volume: 撒丁王国／意大利王国：MedalBook目录正式奖励第五包（剩余差集）
scope: 从已完成的 MedalBook 撒丁／意大利王国 5 页、343 对象页缓存中，补录未出现在意大利包2—4的正式国家或法定机构奖励；排除非正式部队/私人纪念章、社团徽章、绶带-only候选与重复。

families.name_original: Order of the Roman Eagle
families.date_note: 1942-03-14（目录所记设立日期；正式法令版本待进一步核对）
families.selection_basis: MedalBook object pages identify this as an Italian royal order founded in 1942; levels and sword/wreath variants stay in one family.

families.awarding_authority: Kingdom of Sardinia; Kingdom of Italy
families.name_zh: 萨伏依军事勋章（第二型）
families.name_original: Military Order of Savoy, Type II
families.date_note: 1855—1946（第二型使用期；勋章制度源于1815）
families.selection_basis: MedalBook groups the Type II 1855–1946 grades under the Military Order of Savoy; Commander through Grand Cross and breast-star rows are kept in one family.

families.awarding_authority: House of Savoy; Kingdom of Italy
families.name_zh: 圣莫里斯与拉撒路勋章
families.name_original: Order of St. Maurice and St. Lazarus
families.date_note: 1572（合并后制度时期；后续王国等级延续）
families.selection_basis: The order is a formal dynastic/state chivalric order; the catalogue’s seven grade/star rows remain one award family.

families.name_original: Order of the Colonial Star of Italy
families.date_note: 1914（目录日期候选；精确法令日待核）
families.selection_basis: Formal Italian colonial order; Commander through Grand Cross breast-star rows remain in one family.

families.name_original: Order of the Crown of Italy
families.selection_basis: Formal state order instituted under Victor Emmanuel II; the catalogue grades and breast-star variants remain one family.

families.awarding_authority: House of Savoy; Kingdom of Italy
families.name_original: Order of the Most Holy Annunciation
families.date_note: 1362（萨伏依王朝制度沿革；具体王国版期待考）
families.selection_basis: Formal dynastic order; catalogue images for breast-star and collar forms are marked as illustrations where the source labels them so.

families.name_original: Medal for Italian Unification
families.selection_basis: Formal royal commemorative award; bronze and silver material rows are kept in one family.

families.name_original: Commemorative Medal for Work in East Africa
families.selection_basis: MedalBook history identifies a royal-decree award for qualifying work in East Africa; this is not a unit souvenir.

families.name_zh: 西班牙战役纪念十字章
families.name_original: Commemorative Cross for the Spanish Campaign
families.selection_basis: MedalBook history describes this as an officially founded cross recognizing merit and bravery in the Spanish Campaign.

families.name_original: Commemorative Medal for the Italian-Austrian War, 1915–1918
families.selection_basis: The official 1920 royal decree is used for the institution date; the MedalBook bronze soldier row supplies the object images.

families.name_original: Commemorative Cross for the 2nd Division
families.selection_basis: MedalBook history explicitly attributes this commemorative cross to the Kingdom of Italy; it is retained as a formal institutional award pending decree-level citation.

families.name_original: Commemorative Medals for the Spanish Campaign
families.date_note: 1938起源；1942纳入意大利官方授予体系（来源说明）
families.selection_basis: The catalogue notes an originally unofficial 1938 issue later made official by the Italian government in 1942; only the official-form family is included and the caveat remains in the row.

families.awarding_authority: Opera Nazionale Balilla; Kingdom of Italy
families.name_zh: 国家巴利拉组织功绩十字章
families.name_original: Cross of Merit for Opera Nazionale Balilla (Young Italians)
families.selection_basis: A formal award of the state youth organization Opera Nazionale Balilla; boys and girls material forms are variants of one institutional award, not private club badges.

families.awarding_authority: Gioventù Italiana del Littorio; Kingdom of Italy
families.name_zh: 意大利法西斯青年功绩十字章
families.name_original: Cross of Merit of the Italian Fascist Youth
families.selection_basis: A formal fascist-era state youth-organization award. It is retained with a clear institutional/political note and is not counted as a generic unit souvenir.

families.awarding_authority: Kingdom of Sardinia; Kingdom of Italy
families.name_zh: 毛里齐亚纳军事功绩奖章
families.name_original: Military Merit Mauritiana Medal
families.selection_basis: Formal military merit award founded under Charles Albert; the large/small size distinction is a variant distinction within one family.

families.name_zh: 公共福利功绩奖章（第一型）
families.name_original: Medal for Meritorious Public Welfare, Type I
families.selection_basis: Formal public-welfare merit award. The MedalBook bronze object is retained with its maker stamp in the variant note; no material inference is made from colour.

families.awarding_authority: Kingdom of Italy; Ministry of Public Education
families.name_original: Medal for Merit of the People's Education
families.selection_basis: The selected Type II silver row is a state Ministry of Public Education award. Memoria Scolastica independently records the 1904 royal decree and medal type; the family is not split by material.

families.awarding_authority: Kingdom of Italy; Ministry of Foreign Affairs
families.name_zh: 意大利海外学校功绩奖章
families.name_original: Medal of Merit for Italian Schools Abroad
families.selection_basis: The selected Type II bronze/silver rows are a Ministry of Foreign Affairs award instituted by the 1889 decree and amended in 1894; grade/material remain variants of one family.

families.name_original: Order of Merit in Labour
families.selection_basis: The MedalBook candidate page identifies the Knight’s Cross of this formal order. The external 1924 Kingdom-of-Italy specimen is used only as a sourced image supplement; it is not claimed to be the same object as the MedalBook page.

families.awarding_authority: Kingdom of Sardinia; Kingdom of Italy
families.name_original: Medal for Naval Valour
families.date_note: 1836-03-01（撒丁王国主权决定；1860年王国改革）
families.selection_basis: The candidate is the formal naval-valour award, not the separate post-1997 Naval Merit Medal. The 1836 institution and 1860 reform are cross-checked against the Italian legal-history page and the cited Gazzetta decree; the external image is clearly marked as a vendor specimen.
